title: How to Build a Habit Tracker App Without Code (2026)
summary: Build a habit tracker app with streaks, reminders, and analytics in an afternoon. No Supabase, no Vercel config — database and auth are included. Step-by-step guide.
body_markdown: Under two hours from first prompt to deployed app. The database, auth, and habit tracking logic are generated from your description. You spend the remaining time customizing the UI and testing reminders. A developer building from scratch typically needs 20–40 hours for the same feature set.
